verdict.rationale: Polar documents registrable outbound webhook endpoints for asynchronous event notifications, so consumers don't have to poll (polar-docs-21). They follow the Standard Webhooks spec with SDK signature validation and fully typed payloads, endpoint CRUD via a Webhook Events API, and delivery monitoring (polar-supp-webhooks, polar-docs-22). Local testing via `polar listen`, framework adapters, and a customer-state webhook event round out a programmatic integration path (polar-docs-37, polar-docs-39, polar-docs-34). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery, and explicit documentation of retry semantics and the full event catalog in the evidence.
